retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast mid-century graphic style featuring a central hand-lettered title integrated into an abstract, upside-down character silhouette against a solid black field.
triggerTerms: hand-drawn blocky typography integrated with figure
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are requested
complex 3D lighting or gradients are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, graphic composition dominated by a solid black background. The focal point is a stylized, upside-down female figure whose torso is formed by large, hand-lettered block text. The figure features simplified limbs in vibrant orange and pink, with hair represented by rhythmic, dotted magenta lines. Supporting text is arranged in a clean, centered hierarchy using a condensed sans-serif typeface.
coreVisualRelationships: Integration of typography as the physical body of the subject
High-contrast relationship between vibrant warm tones and a deep black void
Inverted orientation of the central figure creating visual tension
Juxtaposition of organic, dotted line-work with heavy, geometric block lettering
coreInvariants: Dotted line patterns for hair or texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central figure is positioned in the upper-left quadrant, scaled to occupy approximately 40% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy, orange block-lettered title serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left with the inverted legs, follows the lettered torso down to the head, and then moves right to the centered credits.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of negative space (black) to isolate the subject and the text blocks.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta and Pink (Hair and Secondary Limbs)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation colors against a zero-value black background for maximum pop.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed, heavy sans-serif with irregular, hand-drawn edges.
letterConstructionRules: Letters must follow the contour of a tapering torso shape
Vertical strokes are elongated and slightly curved
Negative space within letters is minimal
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letters are warped to fit a funnel-like silhouette, wider at the top (hips) and narrower at the bottom (neck).
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact illustrated display type paired with functional, clean condensed sans-serif for information.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, mid-century information hierarchy needed for the credits.
The main title must be hand-drawn to achieve the integrated torso effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black background with an abstract, upside-down silhouette of a figure. The figure should have orange legs at the top, a pink arm, and a head at the bottom with magenta dotted-line hair. Leave the torso area as a blank orange shape for text integration.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom hand-lettered blocky text in orange over the torso area, tapering the letters to fit the shape. Add centered white condensed sans-serif text in the lower right area for credits.

verificationChecks: Is the main figure upside down?
Is the title text integrated into the torso shape?
Are the hair lines represented by dots?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the dotted hair pattern
Degree of taper in the torso lettering
mustRedesign: Any specific celebrity names or likenesses

mustAchieve: Sharp, clean edges on graphic elements
Perfectly centered text blocks for credits

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the warp
Verify the dotted lines do not bleed into the black background
Check that the composition feels balanced despite the asymmetrical subject
Confirm the absence of any modern digital effects like drop shadows
recipe.reuseFormula: Inverted Graphic Silhouette + Integrated Block Lettering + Dotted Line Accents + Solid Black Field
